method: Targeted local rule screen of 32 formerly withheld bodies, not a model judgment or verified-truth evaluation. Only redacted text before the first sensitive marker was visible; remainder withheld. Target classifications frozen before context; sender, attachments and exact values unavailable. Not prevalence.

caveats: target-only labels frozen before packet access and preserved unchanged
outbound cues are staff-like reports only; no independent HMS readback or payment verification
sender identity redacted; cannot establish guest/staff/system authorship beyond direction
earlier/later prefixes are also lossy and can omit conditions/refusals/outcomes
later packet is subject to seven-day censoring
sample selected by withheld-tail flag only; not population prevalence

context_delta.interpretation_caveat: later and earlier text may quote history; cue presence is not proof of a request, HMS write, payment, or guest identity
